faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: The short version of how Puzzled works.

free.question: Is Puzzled free?
free.answer: Today's featured puzzle is free every day and never needs payment or an account; Plus opens every other game and the archive.

account.question: Do I need an account to play?
account.answer: No. You can finish today's free puzzle as a guest. An account keeps your streak, results and stats across devices.

schedule.question: When do new puzzles appear?
schedule.answer: Every day at midnight, Hong Kong time. Everyone plays the same set on the same day, which is what makes shared results comparable.

streak.question: How do streaks work?
streak.answer: Finish at least one qualifying puzzle in a puzzle day to extend your streak. A single missed day does not erase your history.

share.question: Can I share my result without spoiling it?
share.answer: Yes. The result card shows your solving pattern, the puzzle and the day — never the solution. Anyone who opens it plays the same day's puzzle.

catalog.question: Which puzzles are included?
catalog.answer: Nineteen daily puzzles across words, logic, numbers, spatial play and light entertainment, all following the same daily ritual.
